vetSays.line: 🛡️ Angela, Everett and Gregorio met them at the door — 3 put down. Angela, Everett, Gregorio are hurt.
🛡️ Everett, Gregorio, Taye and Meera met them at the door — 4 put down. Everett, Gregorio, Taye, Meera are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Angela, Everett and Gregorio met them at the door — 3 put down. Angela, Everett, Gregorio are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gregorio just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gregorio and Meera met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Gregorio, Meera are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniyar just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Katarina taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Katarina is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl and Leo met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Vasyl, Leo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl and Leo met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Vasyl, Leo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl and Leo met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Vasyl, Leo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl, Leo and Ruth met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Vasyl, Ruth are hurt.

Ruth: "Vasyl and Leo blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 5 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
